switches.name: --min-keep

switches.name: --no-behaviour

switches.name: --no-cache
switches.label: Disable prompt caches

switches.note: Enable it when MTP must run without the supplied draft head.

switches.name: --no-prompt-lookup

switches.name: --port

switches.name: --prefill-chunk

switches.name: --preserve-thinking

switches.name: --prompt-lookup

switches.name: --reasoning-effort
